profile.name: Modbus RTU 从站串口工作器
profile.description: 这是一个非物理软件组件，用于管理与 Modbus RTU 主站设备之间的串口通信。它负责接收和组装 RTU 帧、校验 CRC、处理请求 PDU，并可将请求转发到 Modbus 服务端后返回响应，适合实验系统中的串口协议网关、仿真从站或通信桥接场景。
profile.description_en: This is a non-physical software component for managing serial communication with a Modbus RTU master device. It receives and assembles RTU frames, validates CRC, processes request PDUs, and can relay requests to a Modbus server before sending responses back. It is suitable for protocol gateways, simulated slaves, and communication bridging in laboratory systems.
